Website describes health, wellness, educational and career programming for youth ages 13-24, consistent with OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' contracts
research.notes: Medium confidence: no public registry (ProPublica returned 429, IRS returned 403) and no independent page linking the organization to OUSD or Castlemont High School was found (the Castlemont school homepage does not mention it). profile.summary: Youth UpRising is a nonprofit in East Oakland that works to develop leadership among young people and improve the systems that affect them. It offers health, wellness, education, career, arts and cultural programs for youth and young adults ages 13 to 24 in Alameda County.
